$comment: The render context for templates/wlogout/style.css.tpl. Five names, all absolute paths or tunables the consumer resolves; the template reads them in `{{ }}` interpolations only.
title: wlogout/style.css.tpl — render context
description: Every value the wlogout stylesheet reads: the palette import, the runtime state-root pointers for icons and the current wallpaper, and the two font tunables.

COLORS_FILE_PATH.description: Absolute path to the rendered GTK palette fragment the stylesheet @imports (color-scheme-generator output consumed by the bar).

CURRENT_WALLPAPER_SYMLINK.description: Absolute path to the runtime-owned current wallpaper (window background). A stale or empty path renders a black window, not an error.

STATE_ROOT.description: The runtime state root; the six button icons are read from <STATE_ROOT>/dotfiles/current/icons/. Absolute by construction.

SYSTEM_FONT_FAMILY.description: CSS font-family list (a tunable, not a path). Must be non-empty: an empty value is an invalid CSS declaration.

FONT_SIZE_PX.description: Base font size in px. Integer because the template appends `px` itself (`{{FONT_SIZE_PX}}px`); a string carrying its own unit would render `14pxpx`.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback on any of the five: an empty import path or icon root produces a stylesheet that loads and shows nothing — the failure this contract makes visible.
x-render-contract.destination: The consumer renders this to style.css beside the copied layout; this repository never ships the rendered file (AD-11).
